 Avengers: Doomsday Preview to Debut During MLB World Series
 Friday, 23 October 2026, 01:11 
 Photo source: IGN 
 An exclusive preview will air during Game 1 of the World Series, though it is not yet clear whether it will be a new trailer or a clip from the film. 
 The Tampa Bay Rays and Milwaukee Brewers are scheduled to play Game 1 on Friday, October 23, with the game set to begin at 8 p.m. Eastern time. MLB confirmed the preview will air during the game but has not announced an exact time. IGN speculates it could appear later in the broadcast to keep viewers watching.
 This is reported by IGN .
 The preview is also expected to become available online, either through official Marvel channels or as a fan reupload. It is unclear whether it will be a new trailer or an extended film clip. Two trailers have been released so far, showing a large cast of heroes facing Doctor Doom. Marvel has kept most of the plot under wraps, though Doom is expected to trigger an incursion that causes two universes to collide.
 Advertisement 
 The recent re-release of Avengers: Endgame included new scenes that hint at events in Doomsday. In the added ending, Doctor Doom abducts Hulk, while the TVA begins witnessing the multiverse fall apart through incursions.
 Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled to open on December 18, the same day as Dune: Part Three. The films are expected to compete at the box office, with Dune having access to exclusive IMAX screens. There has been speculation that Doomsday could get an IMAX release later, as Spider-Man: Brand New Day did. The film is expected to receive an IMAX release in China, which could give Marvel a version to release in other territories.
 Doomsday is also expected to be the first part of a two-film story, following the structure of Infinity War and Endgame. Avengers: Secret Wars is currently scheduled for release next December, though it could be delayed; production reportedly has not properly begun. The film may also feature characters absent from Doomsday. Some have speculated that Star-Lord could return after recent comments from Chris Pratt.
